tasks.title: Design EXP-SSI-S1 experiment contract (transcript leakage gate)

handoff.objective: Design a frozen, falsifiable experiment contract for SSI-S1 (SQIsign transcript leakage test) satisfying RT-CTRL-001.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the SSI-S1 transcript-leakage hypothesis has a falsifiable experimental specification with concrete statistic, simulator, parameters, and threshold.
constraints: Must name exact statistic (e.g. KL divergence on degree distribution, chi-squared on response coefficient, mutual information on challenge/secret)
Must specify simulator construction with calibration acceptance criteria
Must name concrete toy SQIsign parameter set (prime, security level, transcript count)
Must preregister effect-size threshold (minimum distinguishing advantage)
Must include stop_rules, controls (true simulator null, shuffled-secret, independent-key), budget, seed policy
Must separate simulator construction budget from statistical testing budget
Must state what a positive result means (leakage detection) and what it does NOT mean (not key recovery, not cryptographic-scale)
Must include a preregistration manifest as first artifact before any transcript generation
Broken SIDH/SIKE torsion-image setting is out of scope as positive target
completion_gate: Contract names exact statistic with mathematical definition
Simulator construction method is specified with calibration acceptance criteria
Toy SQIsign parameter set is named (concrete prime p, number of transcripts n, security level)
Effect-size threshold is quantified (minimum distinguishing advantage epsilon)
All stop_rules and controls are explicit
Budget separates simulator construction from statistical testing

handoff.objective: Commit and verify the EXP-SSI-S1 experiment contract before independent review.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the experiment contract is durably archived and source-bound.
constraints: Run alone; stage only declared producer and receipt paths.
completion_gate: Git verifies parent, exact paths, hashes, task ID, and reachable commit.

handoff.objective: Validate that the EXP-SSI-S1 experiment contract satisfies RT-CTRL-001 and is experimentally sound.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the experiment contract is falsifiable, properly controlled, and ready for execution.
constraints: Independent session; do not edit producer artifacts or official state.
Check each RT-CTRL-001 element: (1) named statistic, (2) simulator construction, (3) parameter set, (4) effect-size threshold.
Check controls: true simulator null, shuffled-secret, independent-key.
Check that budget is separately allocated for simulator vs testing.
Verdict: APPROVE, REVISE (with specific requirements), or REJECT.
completion_gate: Each RT-CTRL-001 element is checked against the contract with PASS/FAIL
Controls and stop-rules are validated for completeness
A clear verdict (APPROVE/REVISE/REJECT) is stated with rationale
